account: Just before 4 a.m. on 8 November 2023, a passenger on a Metro bus in Hollywood reported an armed man aboard. The bus was at Melrose and Western avenues. The driver pulled over and evacuated the other passengers. Officers got no response from the man, and a two-hour standoff followed (Los Angeles Times via Police1, 9 November 2023). The LAPD sent in its Boston Dynamics Spot quadruped. Police1 attributes the initial observation to the quadruped’s camera. The original LAPD quarterly report instead states that a drone observed the sleeping man and the suspected gun before the quadruped entered. The original LAPD report states that the quadruped climbed the bus steps and formed a barrier between the man and the suspected firearm. It does not describe the robot removing the weapon. The man woke, left the bus and was taken into custody about 6:40 a.m. The weapon was a BB gun (Police1). Deputy Chief David Kowalski approves each use. The robot cost nearly $300,000 (NBC). International Business Times' October 2024 account says the robot removed the gun.

fields.account: Just before 4 a.m. on 8 November 2023, a passenger on a Metro bus in Hollywood reported an armed man aboard. The bus was at Melrose and Western avenues. The driver pulled over and evacuated the other passengers. Officers got no response from the man, and a two-hour standoff followed (Los Angeles Times via Police1, 9 November 2023). The LAPD sent in its Boston Dynamics Spot quadruped. Police1 attributes the initial observation to the quadruped’s camera. The original LAPD quarterly report instead states that a drone observed the sleeping man and the suspected gun before the quadruped entered. The original LAPD report states that the quadruped climbed the bus steps and formed a barrier between the man and the suspected firearm. It does not describe the robot removing the weapon. The man woke, left the bus and was taken into custody about 6:40 a.m. The weapon was a BB gun (Police1). Deputy Chief David Kowalski approves each use. The robot cost nearly $300,000 (NBC). International Business Times' October 2024 account says the robot removed the gun.
